links.outcome: Internal validation of model performance using cross-validation on single-center data
links.effect: 5-fold cross-validation on 169 patients at a single center; micro-averaged AUC 0.94 (95% CI 0.92–0.96), accuracy 82%; no external validation.
links.quote: We developed and internally validated an AdaBoost classifier using electronic health record and CGA data from 169 patients aged ≥ 70 years undergoing surgery at a single center.

unlisted_practices: Excluding the most uncertain 15% of predictions (human-in-the-loop deferral) raised accuracy to 85% (p = 0.006)

links.quote: The ML model achieved a micro-averaged ROC area under the curve of 0.94 [95% CI 0.92–0.96] and an accuracy of 82% [95% CI 0.76–0.86], representing a significant improvement over standard-of-care decisions (138 vs 124 correct, p = 0.041).

links.effect: Excluding the 15% highest-uncertainty predictions increased remaining accuracy to 85% (p = 0.006).
links.quote: Mimicking a human-in-the-loop strategy, we excluded the 15% of predictions with the highest uncertainty, which increased accuracy for the remaining predictions to 85% (p = 0.006).
